title: Jeni + Vivek
subtitle: Married at Oeschinensee. Honeymooned in Switzerland, Hungary, and Ireland.

stops.name: Oeschinensee
stops.text: We landed in Switzerland on Oct 8th and drove directly to Oeschinensee. On the 9th, we said our vows to each other and got married. We chose this place because, for one, just look at it! But more importantly, this is one of Jeni’s favorite spots in the world. Right after we said our vows, we changed into outdoorsy attire and went on a celebratory hike.

stops.name: Lenk
stops.text: Our honeymoon began with a drive to Lenk for the Fête des Alpes festival, where the cows parade through the streets adorned with elaborate flower crowns. Jeni got some great photos!

stops.text: After a quick stop in Gruyères, we made our way to Geneva for a few days to celebrate our nuptials with friends. Delicious super buttery dinner at Café de Paris! We got the chance to visit the United Nations, and rode bikes to Carouge.

stops.name: Budapest
stops.text: Next up, we flew to a new country for both of us; Hungary! Budapest was lovely, dynamic, and had a cosmopolitan vibe. Some great old-world architecture with super ornate roofs. The bathhouse culture was legit. Our favorite day involved a 40 km bike ride to Szentendre and back. (P.S. Chimney cakes are overrated lol)

stops.name: Galway
stops.text: Another new country for us as we flew over to Ireland. We landed in Dublin and immediately drove out to Galway, a charming little town on the west side of the country. Irish people are the best. The vibe was lively, with plenty of great live music and pockets of street art and artists.

stops.name: Sligo
stops.text: Our intention was to make multiple scenic stops along Connemara and the Wild Atlantic Way for some dramatic scenery and photos, but the rainy weather made that difficult. We managed to brave strong winds at Dog's Bay before making it to Sligo, where Jeni fell in love with sheep. All of them. We enjoyed some great mead, beer, and barley wine at the Lough Gill brewery, relished a luxurious seaweed (for Jeni) and salt (for Vivek) bath at the Voya Bathhouse, and took in the magnificent scenery at the Gleniff Horseshoe.

stops.name: Dublin
stops.text: The final stop of our trip that went by in a Flash (lol). We took in the festivities with a great acoustic-duo cover band, and of course, gorged on lots of good food and drink and desserts. And finally, we wrote each other "love notes" on dollar bills and pinned them at the Hairy Lemon Pub :)
